source_review.hybrid_gate: 9B experimental_speculation metadata plus explicit InferenceEngine(experimental_hybrid_speculation=True) permits experimental modes. Published registry/API/UI still advertise baseline-only; no implicit exposure of unverified speculation.
source_review.hybrid_restore: Locked MLX-LM0.32.2 KVCache.state includes keys/values/offset; ArraysCache.state includes recurrent cache/left_padding/lengths. Snapshot/restore assigns copied state to original instances; no recurrent trim or container replacement.
source_review.exit_prefix: For partial/short/close exits restore target then replay gold plus emitted outputs except final output. Draft state retained only when its consumed prefix already equals real consumed history; otherwise restore and replay pending plus consumed prefix.
source_review.zero_budget_and_error: Zero budget avoids draft forward and accumulates actual pending input. Positive-budget pre-yield errors restore snapshots and abort uncompleted persistent policy state. Zero-budget device error discards request-local caches; no guessed successful continuation.
source_review.natural_lag: Existing trimmable catch-up normalization max(0,len(draft_y)-2) retained. Hybrid raw pending diagnostic differs from normalized policy catch-up by natural one-token lag; independent trace verifier explicitly converts this boundary.
source_review.nested_kv_budget: attention_config resolves actual nested text metadata and counts only full_attention layers (or validated full_attention_interval) for both target/draft. Recurrent/temporary reserve remains a heuristic rather than physical hard-cap guarantee.
source_review.sampling_history: Manual baseline prefix tokens[:-1] and cached native prefix tokens[:hit] are prepended to MLX generator-owned suffix/history exactly once. Presence processor uses full context0, matching original locked MLX semantics.
source_review.sampler_and_seed: Sampler/processor kwargs forwarded in baseline/native. Seed applied after target and optional draft load, before generation. KV identity depends on exact prompt/model/template/quantization, not sampler; prompt snapshot predates output sampling.
source_review.greedy_gate: GenerationRequest and ChatRequest reject non-default temperature/top_p/top_k/presence_penalty for fixed/adaptive modes. Seed alone is allowed because greedy does not consume sampling randomness.
source_review.transport: API forbids extra fields; bounded finite sampler values and strict top_k/seed validated. API forwards sampling/cache/thinking fields. CLI uses typed flags and GenerationRequest checks; UI preset explicitly supplies supported baseline settings and disables unsupported modes.
source_review.dependency_boundary: New runtime modules use stdlib at import time; MLX/sample_utils imports remain lazy and available through pinned mlx-lm extra. Wheel includes hybrid_speculative.py, sampling.py and ds/mtp_varlen.py.
source_review.quality_source: Frozen quality manifest hashes actual source/harness/scorers/locks; inspected47 frozen files all match. Runner records source_start, source_end and frozen_source; runtime source manifests do not independently hash harness, so frozen archive manifest is required for formal source attribution.
